item: a PowerShell record row that skips the lock or cannot be written now says so
summary: Run 43552997010 lost 1 of 8 PowerShell exit rows and left 24 lines, which takes an append that skipped both the lock and the trim. Every path that appends without the named mutex (no mutex, a wait that threw, a fallback wait run out, the deferred child's mutex or wait failing) and every failed trim now writes one fixed-words stderr line, so the next red names its path; a launcher whose append failed five times now says so instead of dropping its exit row in silence. Cause not yet isolated (no PowerShell where it was examined).
